answer: A hostile operator running 148 aliases as a result needs 122 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in pigment, expire in plume, and umber lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 840 identities would post 2484 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
